subject: english
question:
**Select the word which means the same as the group of words given.**

Person who moves from one place to another, with intentions of finding work and settling, permanently or temporarily, at a new location
solution:
The correct answer is: **Migrant**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Migrant** means a person who travels to another place or country, usually in order to find work.

 
 
• **Example -** *The cities are full of **migrants **looking for work.*
 
 
 
• So it is clear that **'Migrant'** and **"Person who moves from one place to another, with intentions of finding work and settling, permanently or temporarily, at a new location"** are similar in meaning.

Therefore the correct answer is **option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Nomad** means a member of a people that travels from place to place to find fresh pasture for its animals and has no permanent home.
 
• **Tramp** means a person who travels from place to place on foot in search of work or as a vagrant or beggar.
 
• **Vagrant** means a person without a settled home or regular work who wanders from place to place and lives by begging.
